author: Vieillot, 1818
status: 여름철새 10만 마리 이상 · 겨울철새 수만 마리
summary: 우리나라 무인도에서 번식하고 겨울도 나는 흔한 여름철새이자 겨울철새로, 해안과 강, 하구, 하천에서 볼 수 있다. 서해안과 남해안의 무인도에 큰 무리를 이루어 번식하며, 이른 봄부터 모여들어 8월까지 번식을 이어 간다. 물고기 떼가 모이는 곳에 잘 모이고 물고기, 곤충, 물풀 등을 먹는다. 고양이 울음과 비슷한 소리를 낸다고 해서 이 이름이 붙었다.

art.subject: Black-tailed Gull (Larus crassirostris), adult in breeding plumage (spring and summer at Korean island colonies): head, neck, underparts and rump pure white; mantle and upperwing dark slate-grey; folded primaries black with tiny white tips or none; a narrow white trailing edge to the inner wing; tail white with a broad black band near the end and a thin white tip; bill yellow with a black band near the tip and a red tip beyond it; pale yellow iris with a red orbital ring; yellow legs and feet.
art.pose: standing on a rocky islet among a breeding colony, side view
art.scene: Korean uninhabited islet off the west coast in spring, rocky slopes with patches of grass; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage, side view standing: white head and body, dark slate-grey back and wings, black wingtips projecting beyond the tail, yellow bill with a black band and a red tip, yellow eye with red orbital ring, yellow legs
adult winter plumage (October to February), side view standing: as in breeding plumage, but the hindcrown and nape streaked grey-brown
adult in flight seen from above, head, body and tail in line: dark grey upperwing with black outer primaries and a white trailing edge, white rump, white tail with a broad black band near the tip
juvenile, side view standing: dark chocolate-brown all over with paler fringes on the back and wings, paler around the bill base, pink bill with a black tip, pink legs
art.build: Medium-sized gull, clearly larger than a feral pigeon and smaller than the big white-headed gulls such as Vega Gull; slim, long-winged and elegant, with a gently rounded head. Bill fairly long and parallel-sided, about as long as the head, with a slight angle on the lower mandible. Legs medium length, yellow. At rest the long black wingtips project well beyond the tail. Tail square, white with a broad black band. In flight long narrow wings, dark grey above with black outer primaries and a white trailing edge.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow bill with just a red spot near the tip, as in Vega or Slaty-backed Gull; this species has a black band and a red tip.
Do not paint an all-white tail; the adult has a broad black tail band.
Do not paint pale grey upperparts like Common or Vega Gull; the back is dark slate-grey.
Do not give adults pink legs or a dark eye; legs are yellow and the eye pale yellow.
